description:
A multi-platform proxy client based on Clash Meta,simple and easy to use, open-source and ad-free.


Features
- ui Rework the app UI and refresh the localization
- app Rework the app layer and window handling, and add proxy authentication
- desktop Rework the desktop runners, packaging, and native build
- android Rework the Android VPN service and lifecycle handling
- plugins Rework the desktop plugins and add the Helper service and Rust bridge
- core Rework the core IPC and process lifecycle
